fixtures: The arena-arrival fixture teleports to the actual first selected room and loads nearby chunks. It does not manufacture clock time, defeats, rewards or a clear, and is not human connector traversal.

The progression fixture places two actual owned rivals near the player and applies the normal owned-hit handler; pickup and XP are earned through the normal server loop. The actual reroll and banish packets produce the displayed budgets.

The progression clock is explicitly compressed from 77 to 6000 active ticks. The normal manager schedules and spawns the headliner; the fixture does not assign boss health, XP, defeats, an evolution opportunity or a reward receipt.
The camera fixture changes orientation only. The visible headliner is alive at full virtual health; the capture is not a victory or a human five-minute survival claim.
The saved debrief is reopened after ordinary inventory, XP, dimension and position restoration. Its 5:02 duration includes the recorded clock compression.

gametest_fixture_limits: Draft controls, evolution dormancy and report sanitization tests call the production model and serialization code; they are not physical combat playthroughs.

Evolution runtime tests use real session-owned mobs, action boundaries and return settlement, with supplied recipe ranks/opportunities and six bounded four-block Line battery samples. The existing movement observer has separate runtime coverage.

Encounter tests use real native bodies and production manager settlement with compressed active clocks, test-region chunk tickets and controlled placement. Midpoint room-three gating is exercised in a generated room; the final-room abort gate, ring geometry and missed-window checks are direct production-model cases.

The 55 base tests establish their controlled assertions. This local evidence does not establish a complete human six-room or thirty-minute session, enjoyment/balance, sustained performance, every provider mob or broad native spell compatibility.
